issues: Document has 205 pages, all landscape A4 with rotation 0deg; no page needed re-rotation. Row 184 (ГОСТ 34104 GMO line list, pages 51-53): a page-break in the source table left a short run of 'Обнаружена/не обнаружена' value cells near the Topas19/2 entry whose corresponding line-name cells could not be unambiguously reattributed to distinct GMO line names in the rendered crop; all clearly legible named GMO lines for that row (47 total) were transcribed with their value, so a few duplicate/ambiguous line entries may be under-counted, but no data was fabricated. Long multi-page okpd2/tnved reference code lists (e.g. rows 176-180, 186, 189-222 'Синтол'/'Вет Фактор' PCR-kit GMO/phytosanitary rows, rows 353-359 weed-identification MP VNIIKR rows) were transcribed as printed, joined with ', ' across page breaks; a few individual dashed/ellipsis-truncated code fragments printed in the source as e.g. '0602 2...' were kept verbatim rather than guessed at. Rows 361 and 362 (seed-lot aprobation instructions) and row 363 list multiple named indicator/value pairs in one numbered table row; each was split into its own JSON row per the one-row-per-indicator rule, with okpd2_code/tnved_code left null because the source row itself carries '-' in those columns. No lab-address or page-number headings were used as tr_section; the document contains no true ТР ТС / раздел section-heading rows in the 'Область аккредитации' table, so tr_section is null on every row.
